_note: Priority (highest first) is env > managed/policy > cli > local > project > user > defaults — i.e. shared-project (.claude/settings.json) BEATS user (~/.claude/settings.json), matching Anthropic's documented order and the 2.1.215 binary's ascending merge chain userSettings,projectSettings,localSettings,flagSettings,policySettings (later-wins). Array fields (trustedDirectories, additionalDirectories, enabledTools, additionalIncludes) concat-dedup in ascending-priority order (lowest first); object fields (sandbox, hooks, permissions) deep-merge; outputStyle is a string in claude-code (settings/types.ts:639) so it is scalar-override like every other non-array/non-object field. Env prefix priority is LINGXI_ > CLAUDE_CODE_ > CLAUDE_ (LingXi-only; claude-code uses only CLAUDE_*). The $schema field is NOT emitted by claude-code @ 6a25909 — we tolerate it on read for future-compat. PII routing: user paths and raw env values go to _PROTO_-prefixed metadata keys per spec §26.2. Regenerated 2026-07-19 to correct an inverted user>project ordering (verified against 2.1.215 binary).
